finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Both interval methods exclude the useful margin against base, pooled, donor and uniform; all primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and uniform useful advantages are excluded under both methods, while pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both. All residual intervals include zero. The residual donor crossed lower endpoint excludes the useful margin only narrowly at full precision. Raw sums exclude useful base advantage under writer resampling but leave it unresolved under crossed resampling; useful pooled and donor advantages remain unresolved under both methods. All raw model-rival intervals include zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Mixed human/model provenance, sparse histories, transferred calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, human-only language-learning claim, epoch/corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
